description: Horror for Build 42, inspired by The Last of Us and Silent Hill. At night zombies hunt, see and hear farther, and Clickers and Runners appear; bodies left on the ground release Echoes. Almost every day distant sirens wail, the fog starts rising and, 30 seconds later, it brings the Otherworld: darkness, radio static and the Faceless. Everything is configurable in sandbox; works in solo and multiplayer.
